reserved_final: not read, materialized, scored or used for decisions
local_adaptation_authorized: User explicitly accepts custom local implementation meeting submission criteria rather than literal example execution.
optimizer: Adam (MLX defaults other than learning rate)
loss_monitor: 40 development rows per class selected by SHA256(event_id), fixed before candidate predictions; 240 rows, label-balanced; full dev used only for later classification evaluation
data_contract: Raw baseline_common.prompt(narrative) + exact reference label + EOS151643. No chat template. Loss targets original positions >=prompt_length and <sequence_length; exclude prompt and padding. No truncation allowed.
sampling: MLX length-bucketed minibatches shuffled with numpy seed0; 600 batches from first pass, no class balancing or reweighting; 2400 exposures (about21% of train). Record IDs and class counts actually seen.
checkpoint_selection: Use final600-step adapter only, no best-checkpoint search or additional run.
technical_checks: only LoRA tensors trainable; frozen base tensor hashes unchanged
five previously declared smoke cases must all pass before full merged classification evaluation
matched full-development raw and letter protocols for adapter and actual reloaded merged artifact
deployment: No numerical deployment threshold added; report regressions, invalid completions and merge drift alongside strongest keyword baseline. Completing training does not approve deployment.
merge: MLX native LoRA fuse into BF16 base; no quantization or upload. Record rounding changes versus attached adapter.
